description: The atmospheric component of IITM-ESMv3-HR is based on the NCEP GFS spectral model, configured at Triangular Cubic Octahedral TCO126 (126 waves) with an effective horizontal resolution of ~67 km. Key physical parameterizations include the Revised Simplified Arakawa–Schubert (SAS) convection scheme (Han et al., 2010), Zhao–Carr cloud microphysics, shortwave and longwave radiation, planetary boundary-layer turbulence, gravity-wave drag, and land–atmosphere surface fluxes. These schemes represent the key processes governing convection, cloud formation, precipitation, radiation and surface–atmosphere interactions.
